name: AlertWise: Mobile & Web Push Notification Service
author: alertwise

sections.description:
AlertWise is a powerful push notification service that helps you grow your website traffic, boost conversions, and re-engage visitors — all without needing an app. Designed for bloggers, affiliate marketers, eCommerce sellers, and businesses of all sizes, AlertWise offers unlimited campaigns, unlimited websites, advanced segmentation, and real-time delivery on both desktop and mobile.

With features like automated drip campaigns, offline notifications, geolocation targeting, customizable prompts, and advanced analytics, AlertWise is your complete marketing automation toolkit — right from your WordPress dashboard.

Whether you’re running a blog, an online store, or a SaaS business, AlertWise lets you deliver personalized, high-performing push messages that your audience will love.

With robust segmentation tools, flexible campaign types, real-time delivery via AWS infrastructure, and in-depth analytics — AlertWise empowers you to personalize every alert and drive repeat visits, clicks, and conversions.

Advanced Key Features

Unlock the full potential of push notifications with an all-in-one solution built for speed, personalization, and conversion.

✅ Unlimited Websites/Apps

Create and manage unlimited websites and apps with a single account — available across all plans, including free.

🎯 Unlimited Campaigns

Launch as many campaigns as you need to engage and convert your audience. No restrictions on any plan.

🔍 Unlimited Segmentation

Build highly targeted segments based on behavior, device, location, language, and more. Use AND/OR filters to create laser-focused messaging.

👥 Unlimited Audience Groups

you can create unlimited audience groups to deliver more relevant and personalized push notifications.

⚡ High-Speed Notification Delivery

AlertWise is built on Amazon AWS cloud infrastructure to ensure fast and reliable delivery of your push notifications across the globe.

🔔 Offline Notification Support

Even when users are offline, your messages are queued and delivered the moment they come back online. Stay top-of-mind without a mobile app.

🧠 Smart Targeting & Audience Grouping

Get granular with targeting using powerful segmentation features:

  • Browser & Device Targeting – Target users based on browser (Chrome, Firefox, etc.) or device type (desktop, mobile, tablet).
  • Geolocation Targeting – Reach users based on country, region, or city for geo-personalized offers.
  • Action-Based Grouping – Group users by subscription date, last sent date, or last click date to personalize your messaging lifecycle.
  • Advanced Filters – Use unlimited AND/OR conditions to create complex targeting logic that’s straightforward to manage.

📢 Campaign Automation That Converts

Run push notification campaigns with complete flexibility and control:

  • Unlimited Campaigns – Never worry about hitting a limit.
  • Multiple Campaign Types – Choose from one-time, recurring, and scheduled campaigns.
  • Drip Campaigns – Set up automated sequences triggered by time or behavior for smarter re-engagement.

🎯 Advanced Segmentation Tools

Deliver notifications with pinpoint accuracy:

  • Device-Based Targeting – Customize messages for desktop, mobile, or tablet users.
  • Geo Segmentation – Run campaigns based on users’ location (city, region, or country).
  • Custom Segments – Filter users by browser, language, date, and more.
  • Engagement-Based Segments – Identify and re-target inactive users or nurture your most active ones.

🧩 Beautiful & Flexible Prompt Templates

AlertWise offers complete visual customization for your opt-in prompts and push templates:

  • Ready-to-Use Templates – Select from professionally designed prompts tailored for sales, updates, announcements, and more.
  • Fully Customizable – Adjust text, images, CTAs, emojis, and layout to match your brand.
  • Multi-Language Support – Reach users in their native language with ease.
  • Live Preview – See real-time changes while editing your notification designs.

📈 In-Depth Analytics

Track your campaign performance with real-time reporting and actionable insights:

  • Daily Reports – View detailed stats: Sent, Viewed, Clicked, CTR, New Subscribers, Unsubscribes.
  • Advanced Filters – Filter data by timeframe: Today, Last 7 Days, 30 Days, Custom Range, and more.
  • Data Visualization – Beautiful charts and graphs make insights easy to interpret.
  • Subscriber-Level Details – View device type, browser, location, time zone, last session, and more. Sort data using a drag-and-drop table.

🔒 Built for Privacy & Compliance

  • 100% GDPR-compliant — no personal data or email required to subscribe
  • Fully encrypted communication between browser and server
  • Supports cookie-less tracking

✅ Summary

With AlertWise, you get enterprise-grade features with zero friction. Whether you’re running a blog, eCommerce site, agency, or SaaS platform — you can:

  • Instantly engage visitors
  • Drive repeat traffic and conversions
  • Automate re-engagement
  • Retain and monetize users

Benefits

With AlertWise Web Push Notifications, you get more than just messages—you get a powerful growth engine for your website:

  • 🚀 Boost Traffic & Revenue – Drive visitors back to your site instantly through real-time alerts, increasing page views and conversions.
  • 👥 Convert Subscribers into Loyal Customers – Personalized messaging helps turn opt‑ins into repeat buyers.
  • ⏱️ Instant Reach – Send rapid-fire push notifications with the power of AlertWise and AWS to deliver millions of messages in minutes.
  • ⚡ High Engagement & Open Rates – Push notifications outperform email and social media for click-throughs thanks to immediate visibility.
  • ♻️ Re‑Engage Inactive Users – Win back lost visitors with targeted reminders and drip campaigns.
  • 🌍 Smart Segmentation – Target by browser, device, location, behavior, and date for maximum relevance.
  • 📈 Scalable Analytics & Insights – Track metrics like sent, viewed, clicked, CTR, and subscriber growth with dynamic reporting.
  • 🔔 Offline Notifications – Deliver queued messages as soon as subscribers come online, even after days.
  • 💬 No App Required – Engage both desktop and mobile users directly via web—no app install needed.
  • 🛠️ Easy WordPress Integration – One-click setup, no coding required, thanks to our WordPress plugin & JavaScript SDK.

How It Works

AlertWise delivers powerful push notifications through a simple, user-friendly workflow:

1. Subscription (Opt‑In)

  • Website visitors are invited to subscribe via a customizable prompt (soft prompt or native browser prompt).
  • No email or personal data is required — just a single click to opt in.

2. Sending Notifications

  • Once subscribed, you can send tailored notifications — rich text, images, emojis, CTAs — to desktop and mobile browsers.
  • Choose immediate delivery or schedule future campaigns (one-off, drip sequence, or re-engagement).

3. Delivery Mechanics

  • Powered by AWS and the standard Web Push API, messages are reliably pushed via service workers — even when users are offline.
  • Delivered as soon as the subscriber’s browser next connects (TTL retained for up to 28 days).

4. User Interaction

  • Notifications appear as clickable alerts on the user’s device/browser.
  • When clicked, they redirect users to specified URLs (landing pages, offers, articles), driving re-engagement and conversions.

5. Analytics & Optimization

  • You’ll get real-time insights including opens, clicks, and CTR.
  • Advanced segmentation, A/B triggers, and audience behaviors optimize engagement over time.

Who Can Use AlertWise

AlertWise is tailor-made for anyone looking to engage, convert, and retain users—without the need for a mobile app. Popular use cases include:

  • 🎯 Bloggers & Content Creators – Notify readers about new posts, videos, newsletters, and announcements.
  • 🛍️ eCommerce & Online Stores – Recover abandoned carts, send promotions, flash sales, back-in-stock alerts, and product updates.
  • 🤝 Affiliate Marketers – Drive clicks and conversions with timely, targeted offers directly to your visitors’ devices.
  • 📚 SaaS, Startups & Entrepreneurs – Re-engage trial users, announce new features, upsells, and onboarding reminders.
  • 📰 News Portals & Media Sites – Deliver breaking news, regional updates, and curated content alerts.
  • 🎓 Agencies & Developers – Integrate fast, flexible push via WordPress plugin or JS SDK for multiple client sites.
  • 🌍 Local & Small Businesses – Send geo-targeted notifications (country, state, city) for events, local offers, and community announcements.
  • 🧩 Non-Profits & Educational Platforms – Share event invites, important updates, fundraising campaigns, and course announcements.
  • 🌐 International Sites & Multilingual Platforms – Communicate in multiple languages and reach global audiences effectively.

In essence, if you run a website or web app and want to:
– Increase site traffic and repeat visits
– Boost user engagement and retention
– Send targeted conversions and reminders
– Operate without the complexity of mobile apps

then AlertWise is the perfect solution for you. It supports WordPress, custom websites, web apps, and works on all major browsers and platforms (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari on desktop & mobile) — with simple setup and global reach.

  • ❓ Frequently Asked Questions

  • 💬 Join the Community
  • 📩 Contact & Support

sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to the Plugins section and click Add New.
  3. Search for the plugin by name Alertwise in the search bar, or click Upload Plugin to upload a plugin ZIP file from your computer.
  4. Click Install Now next to the plugin you want to add.
  5. Once installed, click Activate to enable the plugin on your site.
  6. After activation, look for the plugin’s menu (such as AlertWise) in your WordPress admin sidebar to configure settings or connect your account as needed.
sections.faq:
What does the AlertWise plugin do?

The AlertWise plugin connects your WordPress site to the AlertWise web push notification service. It enables you to collect subscribers, send personalized push notifications, and view analytics—all without writing any code.

Is the AlertWise plugin free to use?

Yes! The plugin is free to download and use. It connects your site to your AlertWise account. The alertWise service offers a generous free plan that includes unlimited websites and campaigns, with additional features available in other plans.

How do I install the plugin?

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for AlertWise, then click Install Now and Activate.
  3. Navigate to Settings → AlertWise and enter your App ID (from your AlertWise account).
  4. Customize your opt-in prompt and start sending notifications!

Do I need coding knowledge to use it?

Not at all. The plugin is designed for non-technical users. Simply install, connect your App ID, and you’re ready to go. Advanced users can optionally integrate our JavaScript SDK for more control.

Will it slow down my WordPress site?

No. The plugin is lightweight and uses asynchronous loading to ensure it doesn’t affect your website performance.

Do notifications work on both desktop and mobile?

Yes! AlertWise supports push notifications on all major desktop and mobile browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Opera, and Safari (macOS/iOS).

Is SSL (HTTPS) required?

Yes, all push notifications require your site to be SSL-enabled to ensure security and compatibility with modern browsers.

Can I target specific users or groups?

Yes. You can create advanced audience segments based on device, location, browser, subscription date, and more directly in your AlertWise dashboard.

Can I customize the notification prompt?

Absolutely. You can choose from several pre-designed prompt styles or fully customize your own with images, emojis, text, and CTAs in multiple languages.

Is there a subscriber limit?

No! All AlertWise plans, including the free one, allow you to collect and manage unlimited subscribers.

Can I schedule notifications?

Yes. AlertWise lets you schedule one-time campaigns, recurring messages, and drip sequences for automated delivery.

How do I track performance?

Your AlertWise dashboard provides real-time analytics including sent count, views, clicks, CTR, subscriber growth, and unsubscriptions. You can also export data as CSV.

Where can I find support?

We offer 24/7 support via email and live chat. You can also refer to our full documentation at https://documentation.alertwise.net.
